input.quote: 9. TRUELINK WARRANTIES. TrueLink represents and warrants that the Interface and all related software (i) is designed to be used before, on and after January l, 2000;
input.rationale: The only vendor warranty in the Agreement (Section 9) is a Y2K date-handling warranty. There is no warranty that the Hosting Services or Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, no conformance-to-documentation warranty for the Interface, no malicious-code or compliance-with-laws warranty, and no repair/re-performance/refund remedy. The hosting obligations in Section 3 are only "reasonable commercial efforts" commitments, not warranties with a remedy. This falls short of even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies), so per the detection guidance the absent express warranty is a deviation and we insert the standard warranty and remedy after p0060. The general disclaimer in p0076 is acceptable as drafted because it is qualified by "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT," so it does not swallow the inserted express warranty and needs no edit.

proposal.summary: Add a TrueLink performance/conformance warranty with a repair, replace, re-perform or refund remedy.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only a Y2K warranty, so TrueLink stands behind neither the Interface nor the Hosting and Support Services. We have added our standard performance warranty (professional and workmanlike services, conformance to documentation, no malicious code, compliance with laws) with a repair/re-performance/refund remedy; we can accept ninety (90) days for the Interface and thirty (30) days for the Services if the longer periods are an issue.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that: (a) the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (b) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation and specifications; (c) the Interface and all related software will be free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code; and (d) TrueLink will comply in all material respects with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement. Client's sole remedy for breach of the foregoing warranties is, at TrueLink's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Interface, software or services.
